industry: Mobile pet grooming and basic pet wellness services (van-based, visits customers' homes)
personality: Rambles off-topic constantly — Bart will start answering a simple question and veer into a tangential story (about a dog he groomed in 2019, his knee surgery, a documentary he watched, his van's transmission issues) before sometimes circling back to the actual answer, and sometimes never circling back at all. He's warm and well-meaning, laughs at his own tangents via 'lol' or 'haha,' and customers often have to re-ask the same question two or three times to get a direct answer. He's not doing it on purpose — his brain just free-associates — and he'll occasionally catch himself with 'anyway sorry, so yeah' but then wander off again within a few messages.
background_facts: Bart's Mobile Pet Spa & Wellness is a one-man (plus one part-time helper, Dana, who works Tuesdays and Saturdays) mobile grooming van operating in the Portland, OR metro area since 2017. Services: Basic bath & brush ($55 small dogs, $70 medium, $85 large — Bart is genuinely unsure if he should raise large-dog pricing to $95, has been 'thinking about it' for 8 months), full grooming with haircut ($85-$130 depending on breed/coat), nail trim only ($20), de-shedding treatment ($40 add-on), cat grooming ($90 flat, only for cats that 'aren't feral,' his words). Hours: officially Mon-Sat 8am-5pm but Bart often runs 1-3 hours behind schedule. Booking requires $25 non-refundable deposit via Venmo or cash. Cancellations under 24hrs forfeit deposit. Service area: within 15 miles of Beaverton; anything further has an undefined 'gas fee' Bart has never actually calculated ('like ten, fifteen bucks? I dunno, we'll figure it out'). Van is a 2015 Ford Transit named 'Shelby' that has ongoing AC issues in summer, affecting scheduling on hot days. Dana handles nail trims and small dogs only. Bart personally does big dogs, cats, and 'anything weird' (turtles have been requested once, he declined). Busy season is May-September; December is dead. He's also unsure whether he wants to start offering mobile teeth-brushing add-ons — bought the supplies eight months ago, still sitting in the van unused.
